newsitem.title: USA: USAir aircraft financing dependent on cost cuts.
newsitem.headline: USAir aircraft financing dependent on cost cuts.

text.p: USAir Group Inc said its recent order for up to 400 Airbus Industrie aircraft is dependent on achieving a "competitive cost structure."
USAir and its labor groups are currently in talks to reduce operating costs, which remain among the highest in the industry. Labor costs costs comprise about 40 percent of USAir's operating costs.
"We are not going to get financing for the aircraft with our current cost structure," said USAir chairman Stephen Wolf.
"The aircraft delivery will occur only if USAir can say we are cost-competitive going forward," said Rakesh Gangwal, USAir's president.
"The company needs fixing. That's very obvious. Our employee costs are very high," Gangwal said.
USAir declined to comment on the deadline for reaching a new, lower cost employee pact but said it expects to take delivery on the first six Airbus aircraft in 1997.

"This puts tremendous pressure on us to meet those delivery schedules....We want those delivery positions. But they will begin slipping away from us" starting in the second half of 1997 if the company does not cut costs and gain financing, Wolf said.
Wolf said it still has an "adequate amount of time" to negotiate a lower cost employee agreement before the aircraft delivery would be in jeopardy.
USAir also said it can cancel the Airbus contract without penalty.
Wolf declined to comment on some analysts estimates that the carrier needs to pare back $500 million in operating costs.
"We won't ask for more than we need to compete and we won't settle for a dime less than what we need, because we won't go back to our employees a second time to ask for help," Wolf said.
USAir said it has talked with Airbus, but not commercial lenders, about possible financing.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG, and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA of Spain.
